statement: Arbitrary direct-sum mixtures of the two natural Omega8+(2) Q1920 twists collapse the collision operator at every multiplicity
marked_Q_image: Q=2^5:A5 of order 1920 in the singular parabolic of Omega8+(2)
base_modules: H_A: natural eight-dimensional twist with dim End_A(H_A)=12
H_B: natural eight-dimensional twist with dim End_A(H_B)=20
unequal_multiplicity_argument: A solution on H_A^a+H_B^b pads by identity collision operators on missing copies to a solution on (H_A+H_B)^max(a,b), so master-module collapse forces the original solution to be identity.
scope: This covers every direct-sum mixture of the two natural orthogonal twists. It does not classify unrelated indecomposable F2[Q]-modules.
